heading: Definitions
lead: Unless specifically provided for otherwise, the definitions contained in section 300gg–91 of this title shall apply with respect to this title.1

notes.text: References in TextThis title, where footnoted in text, is title I of Pub. L. 111–148, Mar. 23, 2010, 124 Stat. 130, which enacted this chapter and enacted, amended, and transferred numerous other sections and notes in the Code. For complete classification of title I to the Code, see Tables.
